tableDescription: Dimension table storing company master data, including Chinese national business registration identity codes.

columnDescriptions.company_id: Unique surrogate key identifying each company record.
columnDescriptions.company_name: Official registered legal name of the company.
columnDescriptions.unified_social_credit_code: China's 18-character national business registration and tax identifier.
columnDescriptions.created_at: Timestamp when the company record was first inserted.
columnDescriptions.updated_at: Timestamp of the most recent modification to the record.

tableDescription: Dimension table cataloguing financial statement line items across balance sheet, income statement, and cash flow statement.

columnDescriptions.item_id: Unique surrogate key identifying each financial statement line item.
columnDescriptions.statement_type: Which financial statement the item belongs to: balance sheet, income statement, or cash flow.
columnDescriptions.item_side: Section classification: asset, liability/equity, income, or cash flow grouping.
columnDescriptions.item_name: Chinese display label of the financial statement line item.
columnDescriptions.row_no: Official row number assigned to this item in the source regulatory statement template.
columnDescriptions.display_order: Sort sequence for rendering items in their original statement order.
columnDescriptions.is_total: Flags whether this item represents a subtotal or grand total row.
columnDescriptions.created_at: Timestamp when the record was first inserted.
columnDescriptions.updated_at: Timestamp when the record was last modified.

tableDescription: Fact table storing financial statement amounts by company, period, and line item, sourced from Excel reports.

columnDescriptions.amount_id: Unique surrogate key identifying each financial amount record.
columnDescriptions.company_id: Foreign key referencing the company in kx_dim_company.
columnDescriptions.item_id: Foreign key referencing the financial line item in kx_dim_financial_item.
columnDescriptions.report_period: Reporting period in YYYYMM format, e.g., 202605.
columnDescriptions.report_date: Last calendar date of the reporting period, e.g., 2026-05-31.
columnDescriptions.fiscal_year: Accounting year to which this amount belongs.
columnDescriptions.fiscal_month: Accounting month number within the fiscal year.
columnDescriptions.statement_type: Financial statement category: balance sheet, income statement, or cash flow.
columnDescriptions.amount_type: Balance or period classification: opening, closing, monthly, YTD, or quarterly.
columnDescriptions.amount: Monetary value in the stated currency unit; NULL if source cell was blank.
columnDescriptions.currency: ISO currency code of the reported amount, e.g., CNY.
columnDescriptions.source_file_name: Original Excel filename retained for data lineage traceability only.
columnDescriptions.source_sheet_name: Source Excel worksheet name for traceability; not for analytics.
columnDescriptions.source_cell: Exact Excel cell reference for traceability; not for analytics.
columnDescriptions.created_at: Timestamp when this record was first inserted.
columnDescriptions.updated_at: Timestamp of the most recent update to this record.

tableDescription: Detailed line-item view of cash flow statements by company and period, covering operating, investing, and financing activities.

columnDescriptions.公司名称: Legal name of the company that filed the cash flow statement.
columnDescriptions.报表期间: Reporting period in YYYYMM format, e.g., 202605 for May 2026.
columnDescriptions.报表日期: Last calendar date of the reporting period, e.g., 2026-05-31.
columnDescriptions.展示顺序: Sequential display order preserving the original financial report layout.
columnDescriptions.行次: Original row number as printed in the source financial statement.
columnDescriptions.项目名称: Cash flow line item label, e.g., receipts from sales or wage payments.
columnDescriptions.本年累计金额: Year-to-date cumulative monetary amount for this cash flow line item.
columnDescriptions.本月金额: Monetary amount for this cash flow line item in the current month.

tableDescription: Balance sheet detail view listing financial statement line items with period-end and year-start balances per company and reporting period.

columnDescriptions.公司名称: Legal name of the reporting company.
columnDescriptions.报表期间: Reporting period in YYYYMM format, e.g., 202605.
columnDescriptions.报表日期: Last calendar day of the reporting period.
columnDescriptions.项目归属: Classifies the line item as asset, liability/equity, income statement, or cash flow.
columnDescriptions.展示顺序: Sequential display order following the original printed report layout.
columnDescriptions.行次: Official row number as printed in the source financial statement.
columnDescriptions.项目名称: Financial statement line item label, including section header rows.
columnDescriptions.期末余额: Monetary balance at the end of the reporting period.
columnDescriptions.年初余额: Monetary balance at the start of the current fiscal year.

tableDescription: Detailed income statement view showing line-item financial figures per company and reporting period, sourced from original Chinese financial reports.

columnDescriptions.公司名称: Legal name of the company reporting the financial statement.
columnDescriptions.报表期间: Reporting period in YYYYMM format identifying the financial month.
columnDescriptions.报表日期: Month-end calendar date corresponding to the reporting period.
columnDescriptions.展示顺序: Display sequence number preserving the original report's row order.
columnDescriptions.行次: Original row number as printed in the source financial report.
columnDescriptions.项目名称: Income statement line item name as labeled in the original report.
columnDescriptions.本年累计金额: Year-to-date cumulative monetary amount for the line item.
columnDescriptions.本月金额: Current month monetary amount for the income statement line item.

tableDescription: Chinese superstore order line items tracking sales transactions with customer, product, geography, financial details, and ETL metadata.

columnDescriptions.row_id: Surrogate integer key uniquely identifying each order line item row.
columnDescriptions.order_id: Business key grouping multiple line items belonging to one order.
columnDescriptions.order_date: Date the customer placed the order.
columnDescriptions.ship_date: Date the order was dispatched for delivery.
columnDescriptions.ship_mode: Delivery speed tier chosen for the shipment, e.g., standard class.
columnDescriptions.customer_id: Unique business identifier for the purchasing customer.
columnDescriptions.customer_name: Full name of the purchasing customer.
columnDescriptions.segment: Market segment of the customer, e.g., consumer or small business.
columnDescriptions.province: Province or autonomous region of the delivery address.
columnDescriptions.country_region: Country or territory of the delivery destination.
columnDescriptions.region: Broad geographic sales region grouping multiple provinces.
columnDescriptions.product_id: Unique identifier for the ordered product SKU.
columnDescriptions.category: Top-level product classification, e.g., office supplies or furniture.
columnDescriptions.sub_category: Second-level product classification within the parent category.
columnDescriptions.product_name: Full descriptive name of the ordered product.
columnDescriptions.sales: Total revenue for the line item after discount is applied.
columnDescriptions.quantity: Number of product units ordered in this line item.
columnDescriptions.discount: Fractional discount rate applied to the line item price.
columnDescriptions.profit: Net profit earned on the line item after deducting costs.
columnDescriptions.postal_code: Postal code of the delivery address; may be empty.
columnDescriptions.source_system: Name of the originating system that provided this data.
columnDescriptions.source_file: File path of the source document from which data was loaded.
columnDescriptions.source_sheet: Worksheet name within the source file containing this data.
columnDescriptions.source_row_number: Row number in the source file for lineage traceability.
columnDescriptions.batch_id: Identifier for the ETL import batch that loaded this record.
columnDescriptions.row_hash: SHA-256 hash of business fields used for change detection and deduplication.
columnDescriptions.is_deleted: Soft-delete flag; 1 indicates logically deleted, 0 indicates active.
columnDescriptions.created_at: Timestamp when the record was first inserted into the database.
columnDescriptions.updated_at: Timestamp of the most recent update to this record.

tableDescription: Maps each sales region to its assigned regional manager, sourced from the Tableau Superstore sample dataset.

columnDescriptions.region: Geographic sales region name, such as Northeast or Central South.
columnDescriptions.regional_manager: Full name of the manager responsible for overseeing this region.
columnDescriptions.source_system: Identifier of the upstream system that provided the data.
columnDescriptions.source_file: File path of the original Excel workbook containing the data.
columnDescriptions.source_sheet: Worksheet name within the source file where data was extracted.
columnDescriptions.source_row_number: Row position in the source file this record originated from.
columnDescriptions.batch_id: Identifier grouping all records loaded together in one import run.
columnDescriptions.row_hash: SHA-256 hash of business fields used to detect row changes.
columnDescriptions.is_deleted: Soft-delete flag; 1 means the record is logically removed.
columnDescriptions.created_at: Timestamp when the record was first inserted into the database.
columnDescriptions.updated_at: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this record.

tableDescription: Records order return status from the Tableau Superstore sample dataset, including ETL lineage and soft-delete audit metadata.

columnDescriptions.id: Surrogate primary key; auto-incrementing unique identifier for each return record.
columnDescriptions.order_id: References the associated sales order that was returned.
columnDescriptions.returned: Flag indicating whether the order was returned; '是' means yes.
columnDescriptions.source_system: Name of the upstream system that originated this data.
columnDescriptions.source_file: File path of the source spreadsheet from which data was extracted.
columnDescriptions.source_sheet: Worksheet tab name within the source file where data resides.
columnDescriptions.source_row_number: Row number in the source file for record-level traceability.
columnDescriptions.batch_id: Identifier for the ETL import batch that loaded this record.
columnDescriptions.row_hash: SHA-256 hash of business fields used to detect duplicate or changed rows.
columnDescriptions.is_deleted: Soft-delete flag; 1 means logically deleted, 0 means active.
columnDescriptions.created_at: Timestamp when the record was first inserted into the database.
columnDescriptions.updated_at: Timestamp of the most recent update to this record.
